description: This file is a TypeScript source code that processes Todoist project data, converting it into a board and block structure for export, including reading input files, creating boards, cards, and views, and handling project columns and cards.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Interface representing a project section with id and name.

classes.name: Todoist
classes.description: Main interface representing the entire Todoist data structure including projects, sections, notes, and items.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses arguments, reads input file, processes projects into boards and blocks, and writes output.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a Todoist project into a board and associated blocks.

methods.name: getProjectColumns
methods.description: Retrieves columns (sections) for a project, defaulting if none are found.

methods.name: getProjectCards
methods.description: Filters items belonging to a specific project.

methods.name: getCardDescription
methods.description: Generates description text for a card, including attachments.
